name: Confessions of a Convert
desc: Benson's account of 1913 of his road from the Anglican priesthood (the son of an Archbishop of Canterbury) to the Catholic Church in 1903: the Church of England as he knew it, the Mirfield years, his doubts and his reception at Woodchester, and what the Church has been to him since.
desc_pt: O relato de Benson (1913) do seu caminho do sacerdócio anglicano (filho de um arcebispo de Cantuária) à Igreja Católica em 1903: a Igreja da Inglaterra como a conheceu, os anos de Mirfield, suas dúvidas e a recepção em Woodchester, e o que a Igreja tem sido para ele desde então.
edition: Confessions of a Convert (London: Longmans, Green, 1913), Internet Archive full-text OCR (confessionsofaco00bensuoft).
